title: WAIT on Prospectus: account creation (kanbus-dbc30a), members and invites (kanbus-2823b5), provisioning events (kanbus-6efecd), selling (kanbus-592fbb, db57cb), billing (kanbus-a78bcd)
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. WAIT tasks: each consumes a Prospectus route or event that is not deployed yet (Prospectus epic kanbus-a93e35). Specified now so the Papyrus side is ready; **do not start a sub-part before its Prospectus dependency is deployed and Ryan has approved the synthesized Prospectus change.** Split into separate tasks when the first dependency lands.

### A. Account creation from a site (WAIT kanbus-dbc30a: sites may call `POST /v1/accounts`; Papyrus PRs 330/331 are refused today; kanbus-5161d7 is blocked by it)
- Console "Create an Account" on the sign-in landing for a person with no account: `app/api/prospectus/accounts/route.ts` POST -> `POST /v1/accounts` as the site role with a retained UUID replay key (Prospectus `accounts-client` README: `create` needs it), `{name}`; the creator becomes the first member; the new account is entitled to `papyrus-<site>` by the server (contract in kanbus-634da2). Gherkin: "A person with no account creates one and is its first member"; "A replayed create returns the same account".
### B. Membership and invite UI (WAIT kanbus-2823b5 members:write; invites kanbus-59284c, kanbus-b2ddb4)
- Console Administration -> "Members": list (`members:read`), invite by email (the address is typed by the admin at run time, never stored in the repo), change role, remove; all through site routes calling the membership routes as the site role with `authorize(members:write)` first. Buttons, no dropdowns; Lucide `user-plus`, `user-minus`, `shield`. Gherkin: "An admin invites a member"; "A member cannot change roles"; "A removed member's next call is denied".
### C. Provisioning on lifecycle events (WAIT kanbus-6efecd; Ryan chooses the transport, recommended EventBridge)
- A `prospectus-events` consumer (plugin `amplify/plugins/prospectus-events/`): on `account.created` + `entitlement.changed(active)` for `papyrus-<site>` create the site's per-account defaults (sections doctrine, first UserProfile for the first member); on `entitlement.changed(disabled)` put the account's console in read-only (`authorize` already denies writes; the plugin only marks the UI); on `membership.changed` refresh cached member lists. Idempotent on event id. Gherkin per event kind.
### D. Selling and entitlement flow (WAIT kanbus-592fbb operator grants, kanbus-db57cb the `papyrus` family)
- Nothing in Papyrus grants entitlements; the site shows "This Account is not entitled to <site>" with the Prospectus directory link when authorize returns `403 operation_forbidden` for a known account. Gherkin: "An account without the entitlement sees the entitlement message and no console data".
### E. Billing (WAIT kanbus-a78bcd, draft)
- No Papyrus work until the Prospectus billing epic defines events; placeholder only.

## Acceptance
Each sub-part becomes its own task with its Gherkin when its dependency is deployed; this task closes when the split is done. No AWS writes.
